summary: Tested Business Bookkeeping landing upgrade (add-on, timers, preview, compare, sticky bar, email dialog, Meta pixel) + backend add-on endpoints + regression of /, /medical-6-combo. Everything requested works. Only minor UX notes.

minor.issue: bookkeeping_only add-on (productivity-execution-bundle) can be ordered alone or duplicated (same slug twice) - no server-side check that it is bundled with business-bookkeeping-system. Could not verify at runtime because the Razorpay key check returns 503 first.

ui_bugs.issue: Input has type=email + required, so for values like 'bad' the browser's own validation bubble shows and the custom buyer-email-error never renders. The custom error only shows for values like 'a@b' that pass native validation but fail the regex. Messaging is inconsistent; consider adding noValidate on the form.

issues: After expiry the urgency bar reads 'ENDS IN SOON' and the hero shows 'Launch price ends in SOON'. The grammar is awkward; consider 'Ending soon' / 'Limited-time price'.

action_items: Optional: add noValidate to the BuyerEmailDialog form so the custom error shows the same way on every device
Optional: fix the post-expiry timer copy ('ENDS IN SOON')
Optional: server-side check that bookkeeping_only add-ons are bought together with the main product, and dedupe items
critical_code_review_comments: sections.jsx is 593 lines, close to the 700-line limit
create_razorpay_order does not dedupe or validate add-on context (see minor backend issue)

UI: timers tick down from 10:00; expired state shows 'soon'/'Limited' with price staying 290; preview has 10 tabs and prev/next works; compare section present; add-on toggles 290->439->290, synced both ways with the dialog; the sticky bar is hidden with translate-y-full until you scroll (so is_visible is true even when off-screen; check transform instead); dialog sits at top 12px on mobile 390; hero CTA scrolls to pricing on the 1st click and opens the dialog on the 2nd; fbq gets 4 inits, 1 PageView, then InitiateCheckout on submit; no horizontal overflow at 390; the combo-6 dialog still works.
